<thought>The team is a balanced offense built around Fake Out and Intimidate support from Incineroar, with Kingambit and Garchomp as strong physical attackers. Gholdengo and Dragapult add special damage and speed control, and Corviknight gives a defensive pivot with Steel and Flying resistances. The aim is to bring 3 that cover each matchup, with Intimidate and Priority moves for consistency in BSS.</thought>

Dragapult
Corviknight
</pokemon>

<thought>Incineroar leads with Intimidate, Fake Out and Parting Shot to set up Kingambit, Mega Garchomp and the special attackers. Gholdengo (Focus Sash) and Dragapult (Life Orb) supply special damage and speed. Corviknight uses Tailwind and Roost as a defensive pivot that resists Steel and Flying, and Mirror Armor lets it ignore opposing Intimidate. Items are all different, and Garchompite is the team's only Mega.</thought>

attempts.reasoning:
I need to plan team sets with unique items, stats capped at 32 per stat and 66 total, and decide to give Garchomp the Garchompite to Mega Evolve, keeping in mind only one Mega per team.

For Incineroar, I'm settling on Fake Out, Flare Blitz, Parting Shot, and Throat Chop with Sitrus Berry, splitting EVs across HP, Defense, and Special Defense with an Impish nature. For Kingambit, I'm giving it a Lum Berry with Kowtow Cleave, Sucker Punch, Iron Head, and Protect, leaning Adamant with HP and Attack investment, before moving on to finalize Garchomp's set.

Now I'm working out Gholdengo's build, weighing Choice Scarf against other items and settling on Make It Rain, Shadow Ball, and Focus Blast as the attacking moves.

For Dragapult, I'm leaning toward Life Orb with Dragon Darts, Shadow Ball, Draco Meteor, and Protect, though Phantom Force and Sucker Punch are also tempting options with a Naive nature.

For Corviknight, I'm settling on Mirror Armor as the ability since it counters Intimidate well, pairing Brave Bird, Body Press, Tailwind, and Roost with Impish nature and bulky Def investment, though Iron Head/Bulk Up are alternatives I considered.
